card.name: Linking words in historical event phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as by, of, as, during right after a place, event or person in a history passage. They come just before the agent, date or name in a historical event, such as 'captured by Napoleon'.

modes.label: By before an agent
modes.description: The word 'by' after a destroyed, captured or defiled place, leading into who did it.
modes.example: After the destruction of both houses of parliament<< by>> fire in 1834,

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Words such as of, as, during or did before a historical name, war or event.
modes.example: In commemoration of the miracle<< of>> the oil that lasted eight days you eat

card.writes: It seems to push toward proper-name beginnings and away from verbs like pull and throw, though the effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words in history texts, just before the name of the person, army or event involved.
